beats.label: S1 · The TVA arrests Loki
beats.text: A 2012 Loki escapes with the Tesseract and is seized by the Time Variance Authority, a bureaucracy that prunes anyone diverging from a Sacred Timeline.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the TVA — the whole apparatus every future beat depends on.

beats.label: S1 · Mobius recruits him
beats.text: Analyst Mobius shows Loki his future — including his own death at Thanos's hands — and recruits him to hunt a rogue Loki variant killing TVA agents.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Mobius and the partnership that carries the whole story; motivates Loki's cooperation.

beats.label: S1 · Sylvie shatters the timeline
beats.text: The variant proves to be Sylvie, a female Loki hiding in apocalypses. She scatters the TVA's reset charges across time, splintering the Sacred Timeline into branches.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Sylvie and the branching multiverse — the two forces that dominate everything after.

beats.label: S1 · The TVA is built on stolen lives
beats.text: Stranded together on a doomed moon, Loki and Sylvie form a bond, and Sylvie reveals that every TVA worker is a memory-wiped variant abducted from Earth.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The revelation that discredits the TVA morally; it fuels every allegiance shift that follows.

beats.label: S1 · The Time-Keepers are fake
beats.text: Loki, Sylvie and turned agent B-15 reach the Time-Keepers and discover they are hollow androids. Judge Renslayer prunes Loki mid-fight.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The TVA's official gods are exposed as a cover story, meaning someone else is really in charge.

beats.label: S1 · The Void and Alioth
beats.text: Pruned Lokis exiled to the Void reunite Loki with Sylvie. Together they tame the cloud-monster Alioth blocking a citadel at the end of time.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the Void as the TVA's dumping ground and clears the road to the citadel where the real power lives.

beats.label: S1 · Sylvie kills He Who Remains
beats.text: He Who Remains admits he built the TVA to prevent a multiversal war between his variants. Sylvie kills him despite Loki's plea, unleashing the branching multiverse.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The single act the entire next season is a response to — his death, and the multiverse it unleashes.

cliffhanger.text: Sylvie has killed the TVA's architect and torn the Sacred Timeline open into an uncontrolled multiverse. Loki is stranded in a TVA that has no memory of him, where a statue of one of He Who Remains' variants now stands in place of the fake Time-Keepers.
questions: Which of He Who Remains' variants is really running this altered TVA?
Can Loki warn Mobius and B-15 in time before the multiverse tears itself apart?
Is Sylvie still out there, and does she regret what she has done?

characters.name: Loki
characters.line: The 2012 variant of the Asgardian trickster, forced into TVA service; now knows the multiverse is real and that the TVA has been lying to him.

characters.name: Sylvie
characters.line: A female Loki variant hunted by the TVA since childhood; killed He Who Remains and shares a romantic bond with our Loki.

characters.name: Mobius M. Mobius
characters.line: The TVA analyst who befriended Loki; back at his desk at season's end, but with no memory of him.

characters.name: He Who Remains
characters.line: The scientist who secretly ran the TVA to prevent a war between his own variants; killed by Sylvie at the end of time.

characters.name: Ravonna Renslayer
characters.line: TVA judge and true believer; walked out of the TVA to hunt 'free will' after learning the Time-Keepers were a lie.

characters.name: Miss Minutes
characters.line: The TVA's animated clock mascot — an AI far more powerful and loyal to He Who Remains than her cartoon appearance suggests.

characters.name: Hunter B-15
characters.line: TVA field agent turned ally after Sylvie showed her she was a variant with a stolen life.

beats.label: S2 · The Loom is failing
beats.text: Loki starts slipping through time uncontrollably. Ouroboros, a TVA technician, warns that the new branches are overloading the Temporal Loom holding reality together.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the Loom, Ouroboros, and the season's ticking clock — every later beat is a response to this crisis.

beats.label: S2 · Dox destroys the branches
beats.text: General Dox's faction bombs every new branch at once. Loki's team stops her, but most branches are already gone, killing countless lives on them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the internal split inside the TVA and the human cost of pruning — the moral weight Loki carries into the finale.

beats.label: S2 · Sylvie walks away
beats.text: Loki finds Sylvie hiding on a branch and asks for help. She refuses, blaming the TVA for everything, and takes He Who Remains' TemPad for herself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks Sylvie's position for the season: outside the TVA, unwilling to save it, unmovable on He Who Remains.

beats.label: S2 · Victor Timely, HWR variant
beats.text: In 1893 Chicago, Loki and Mobius find Victor Timely — a variant of He Who Remains being groomed by Miss Minutes and the rogue Renslayer to rebuild his empire.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the first HWR variant on screen and shows the shape of the threat the reformed TVA will spend years hunting.

beats.label: S2 · Renslayer pruned, Loom detonates
beats.text: Renslayer's forgotten past as He Who Remains' partner is exposed. Sylvie enchants an agent to prune her; Timely is killed approaching the Loom, and it detonates through the TVA.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Clears Renslayer, Miss Minutes and Timely off the board and puts the reader in the finale's collapsing timeline.

beats.label: S2 · Slipping through erased lives
beats.text: Loki slips through branches where his TVA friends live erased original lives on Earth. He learns to steer his slipping by focusing on a person and races back toward the explosion.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows Loki what a world without the TVA looks like and gives him the control he needs to intervene at the end.

beats.label: S2 · Loki takes the throne
beats.text: He Who Remains reveals the Loom prunes every branch to save one timeline. Loki destroys it instead and takes the throne, holding the branching multiverse together alone, forever.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The new status quo: the multiverse survives, but only because Loki is personally holding it up from the End of Time.

cliffhanger.text: Loki now sits alone at the End of Time, personally holding the branching multiverse together as a living tree. Sylvie and Mobius have walked away into quiet lives, and the reformed TVA hunts He Who Remains' other variants across the branches.
questions: Can Loki really hold the multiverse together on his own, indefinitely?
Which of He Who Remains' variants are still free to seize power in the branches?
Will Sylvie and Mobius ever come back, or are their new ordinary lives permanent?

characters.name: Loki
characters.line: Now the god enthroned alone at the End of Time, personally holding the tree of branching timelines together.

characters.name: Sylvie
characters.line: Refused the throne and the TVA; lives quietly on a branched timeline she fought to save.

characters.name: Mobius M. Mobius
characters.line: Retired from the TVA; watches his own original-timeline variant, Don, and his children from afar.

characters.name: Victor Timely
characters.line: A 19th-century inventor and variant of He Who Remains; killed by the Loom before he could take his creator's place.

characters.name: Ouroboros ("O.B.")
characters.line: The TVA technician whose ideas built and unbuilt the Loom; now the practical brain of the reformed TVA.

characters.name: Hunter B-15
characters.line: Now a leader of the reformed TVA, which hunts He Who Remains' variants across the branches.

characters.name: Miss Minutes
characters.line: Deactivated after helping Renslayer, then rebooted as a friendly co-author of the new TVA handbook.

characters.name: Ravonna Renslayer
characters.line: Her power grab failed; pruned into the Void, where she has just been found by Alioth.

characters.name: He Who Remains
characters.line: Still dead — but his warning that his other variants are worse has proven true, and the TVA now hunts them.
